questions.question: If the 4-digit number 48ab is divisible by 2, 5 and 7, then what is the value of (10a - b) ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The 4-digit number 48ab is divisible by 2, 5, and 7.

Concept:

When 48ab is divisible by 2, 5, and 7, it will also be divisible by the LCM of 2, 5, and 7.

Dividend = Divisor x Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

LCM (2, 5, and 7) = 70

By taking the largest 4-digit number 48ab and dividing it by 70.

⇒ 48ab = 69 × 70

⇒ 48ab = 4830

⇒ 48ab = 4830 (where a = 3, b = 0)

Now the value of (10a - b).

⇒ (10a - b)= 10 × 3 - 0 = 30

⇒ 30

∴ The value is 30.

questions.question: A person borrowed Rs. 8000 on compound interest at the rate of 20 percent per annum. If the interest is compounded half yearly. then what will be the amount to be paid after 1.5 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 8000

Rate of interest = 20% per annum

Number of times interest is compounded = 2 (semi-annually)

Time = 1.5 years = 3 half-years

**Formula:**

Compound interest = Principal(1 + R)ⁿ

**Solution:**

Time = 1.5 years = 3 half-years

R = 20/2 = 10%

Compound interest = 8000 (1 + 10)³ = 8 × 1331 = 10648 

**Therefore, the amount to be paid after 1.5 years is Rs. 10648.**

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 9 : 16. If both numbers are increased by 40, then their ratio becomes 2 : 3. What is the difference between the two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The two numbers are in the ratio 9 : 16.

If both numbers are increased by 40, then their ratio becomes 2 : 3.

**Formula:**

Ratio = (First number)/(Second number)

**Solution:**

Let the two numbers be 9x and 16x.

The ratio of the two numbers is 9x : 16x = 9 : 16.

If both numbers are increased by 40, the new ratio becomes (9x + 40) : (16x + 40) = 2 : 3.

Cross-multiplying the two ratios gives:

(9x + 40) × 3 = (16x + 40) × 2

27x + 120 = 32x + 80

5x = 40

x = 8

The two numbers are 9x = 9 × 8 = 72 and 16x = 16 × 8 = 128.

The difference between the two numbers is 128 - 72 = 56.

**Therefore, the difference between the two numbers is 56.**

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 6 : 5 : 9. If 20 percent of the first number is 30, then what would be 50 percent of the difference of third and second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the three numbers is 6 : 5 : 9.

20 percent of the first number is 30.

**Formula:**

Percentage of a number = (number / 100) × 100

Difference of two numbers = First number - Second number

50 percent of a number = (number / 2) × 100

**Solution:**

Let the first number be 6x, the second number be 5x, and the third number be 9x.

20 percent of 6x = 30

⇒ (20/100) × 6x = 30

⇒ 12x = 300

⇒ x = 25

The difference between the third and second numbers is 9x - 5x = 4x = 100

50 percent of 100 = (100 / 2) × 100 = 50

**Therefore, 50 percent of the difference between the third and second numbers is 50.**

questions.question: 8 men or 10 boys can complete a work in 174 days. 12 men and 14 boys will complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8 men or 10 boys can complete a work in 174 days.

**Formula:**

Work = (Men × Days)/(Rate)

**Solution:**

Let the rate of one man be m and the rate of one boy be b.

8m = 10b

m/b = 5/4

Efficiency of Men = 5 and Boys = 4

(12m + 14b) × Days = (8m × 174 days)

(12 × 5 + 14 × 4) × Days = (8 × 5 × 174 days)

(12 × 5 + 14 × 4) × Days = (8 × 5 × 174 days)

116 × Days = (8 × 5 × 174)

6960/116 = 60 Days 

Days = 60

**Therefore, 12 men and 14 boys will complete the same work in 60 days.**

questions.question: The average age of a team having 12 players is 24 years. If the age of the coach is also included, then the average age increases by 2 years. What is the age of the coach?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of a team having 12 players is 24 years.

If the age of the coach is also included, then the average age increases by 2 years.

**Formula:**

Average = Total/Number of items

**Solution:**

The total age of the 12 players is 12 × 24 = 288 years.

If the coach's age is included, the total age of the 13 people is 13 × (24 + 2) = 338 years.

**Therefore, the coach's age is 338 - 288 = 50 years.**

questions.question: A train of length 360 meters crosses an electric pole in 30 seconds and crosses another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the second train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of the train is 360 meters.

The time it takes the train to cross an electric pole is 30 seconds.

The time it takes the train to cross another train of the same length traveling in the opposite direction is 15 seconds.

**Formula:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Relative speed = Speed of 1 + Speed of 2

**Solution:**

The speed of the first train is 360/30 = 12 m/s.

Let the speed of the second train = x m/s

Relative speed = x + 12

Total length of the train = 360 + 360 = 720

Time = 720/(x +12)

15 = 720/(x +12)

(x +12) = 48

x = 36

**The answer is 36 m/s.**

questions.question: Anil sold an article at a loss of 15%. Had he sold it for Rs. 84 more, he would have gained 13%. At what price should he have sold if to gain 20% ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anil sold an article at a loss of 15%.

If he had sold it for Rs. 84 more, he would have gained 13%.

**Formula:**

Selling price = Cost price × (100 + profit%)/100

Cost price = Selling price × (100 - loss%)/100

**Solution:**

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x.

Selling price at a loss of 15% = Rs. 0.85x

Selling price at a gain of 13% = Rs. 1.13x

If he had sold it for Rs. 84 more, he would have gained 13%.

0.85x + 84 = 1.13x

0.28x = 84

x = 300

The cost price of the article is Rs. 300.

To gain 20%, the selling price should be Rs. 360.

Selling price at a gain of 20% = Rs. 1.2x = 1.2 × 300 = Rs. 360

**Therefore, the price at which Anil should have sold the article to gain 20% is Rs. 360.**

questions.question: Two medians DM and EN of ΔDEF intersect each other at G at right angles, If EF = 20 cm and EN = 12 cm, then what is the length of DM?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two medians DM and EN of ΔDEF intersect each other at G at right angles.

EF = 20 cm and EN = 12 cm

**Concept Used:**

Median divides the opposite side into two equal parts.

Centroid is the intersection point of medians which divide the median into the ratio 2 : 1.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecd01c149ec25c38ddee859555eada4f996abf32ad6c2ec1a55e2657cd478b2d.png] 

In ΔDEF EN is the median.

So, EG : GN = 2 : 1

EN = 12 cm

EG : GN = 8 : 4 

In ΔEGM

EM² = GM² + EG²

⇒ 10² = GM² + 8²

⇒ GM² = 100 - 64

⇒ GM = 6

Since DM is also a median

DG : GM = 2 : 1

DG = 2 × GM = 2 × 6 = 12 cm

DM = DG + GM = 12 + 6 = 18 cm

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Find the value of tan x, if sec x + tan x = √3 and x lies between 0° and 90°.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec x + tan x = √3 

x lies between 0° and 90°

**Concept Used:**

sec x = √(1 + tan² x)

**Calculation:**

sec x + tan x = √3 

⇒ √(1 + tan2 x) + tan x = √3 

⇒ √(1 + tan2 x) = √3 - tan x

Squaring both sides

⇒ [√(1 + tan2 x)]² = (√3 - tan x)²

⇒ 1 + tan2 x = 3 + tan² x - 2√3 tan x

⇒ 1 = 3 - 2√3 tan x

⇒ 2√3 tan x = 2

⇒ tan x = 1/√3

∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows the expenditure of two companies J and K in five different years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84f976b8677ddc732ebc7ec82d1b843c7044ca504b8238f87d5169ce8ba69742.png] 

L1 = The difference between average expenditure of company J in year A and B and the average expenditure of company K in year C and D.

L2 = The value of average expenditure of company K in all 5 years,

What is the value of (L2 - L1)?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Average expenditure of company J in year A and B = (400 + 300)/2 = 350

Average expenditure of company K in year C and D = (500 + 300)/2 = 400

L1 = The difference between average expenditure of company J in year A and B and the average expenditure of company K in year C and D

L1 = 400 - 350 = 50

L2 = The value of average expenditure of company K in all 5 years,

L2 = (1000 + 700 + 500 + 300 + 200)/5 = 2700/5 = 540

The value of (L2 - L1) = 540 - 50 = 490

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

 ∠B = 90 degree

AB = 12 cm

BC = 5 cm

**Concept Used:**

Pythagoras Theorem

Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

cos A = Base/Hypotenuse

sin C = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3586df2418ca19cf0362cd35d50b4db600d05c1fecc2bff13729e8249e1cbdd.png] 

 

Apply Pythagoras Theorem

AC2 = BC2 + AB2

⇒ AC² = 5² + 12²

⇒ AC² = 25 + 144

⇒ AC = 13

cos A = Base/Hypotenuse = 12/13

sin C = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse = 12/13

⇒ cos A + sin C = 12/13 + 12/13

⇒ 24/13

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: PX is a tangent drawn from point X, touches the circle at P, O is the centre of the circle. Radius of this circle is 10 cm and OX = 26 cm. What is the length of PX ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PX is a tangent drawn from point X.

O is the centre of the circle.

Radius of this circle is 10 cm and OX = 26 cm.

**Concept Used:**

When a tangent is drawn from an external point to a circle, it forms a right angle with the radius drawn to the point of tangency.

Pythagoras theorem

Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ee89817c09fc0578f923eafdd8cdd8eef34a8343800d5abe4a7c72a518ea676.png] 

Here PX is the tangent makes 90° angle with the radius.

In triangle OPX,

OP = 10 cm

OX = 26 cm

Apply Pythagoras theorem

Hypotenuse2 = Base2 + Perpendicular2

262 = 102 + Perpendicular2

Perpendicular² = 262 - 102 

Perpendicular2 = 676 - 100

Perpendicular2 = 576

Perpendicular = 24 cm

PX = 24 cm

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
